mapper.select: select from basket_captain_qualification where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0
select from basket_captain_qualification where season_id = #{seasonId} and qualification_status = 1 and is_delete = 0

select s.id as seasonId, s.season_name as seasonName, s.season_status as seasonStatus, s.season_end_time as seasonEndTime, t.id as tournamentId, t.tournament_name as tournamentName, t.game_terminal as gameTerminal, cs.season_name as competitionSeasonName, cs.season_year as competitionSeasonYear, concat( case when cs.season_name like '%赛季%' then cs.season_name when cs.season_year is not null then concat(cs.season_year, '赛季') else ifnull(cs.season_name, '赛季') end, ' / ', ifnull(t.game_terminal, 'PC'), ' / ', t.tournament_name ) as displayName from basket_tournament_season s inner join basket_tournament t on t.id = s.tournament_id and t.is_delete = 0 left join basket_competition_season cs on cs.id = t.competition_season_id and cs.is_delete = 0 where s.is_delete = 0 and s.season_status in (0, 1, 2, 4) and s.season_end_time is not null order by s.season_start_time desc, s.id desc
mapper.insert: insert into basket_captain_qualification ( qualification_no, member_id, player_id, season_id, team_id, qualification_status, is_current, payment_confirmed, payment_reference, grant_reason, granted_by, granted_time, valid_from, valid_to, revoke_reason, remark, create_time, update_time, is_delete ) values ( #{qualificationNo}, #{memberId}, #{playerId}, #{seasonId}, #{teamId}, #{qualificationStatus}, #{isCurrent}, #{paymentConfirmed}, #{paymentReference}, #{grantReason}, #{grantedBy}, #{grantedTime}, #{validFrom}, #{validTo}, #{revokeReason}, #{remark}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{isDelete} )

season_id = #{seasonId}, team_id = #{teamId}, qualification_status = #{qualificationStatus}, is_current = #{isCurrent}, payment_confirmed = #{paymentConfirmed}, payment_reference = #{paymentReference}, grant_reason = #{grantReason}, valid_from = #{validFrom}, valid_to = #{validTo}, revoked_by = #{revokedBy}, revoked_time = #{revokedTime}, revoke_reason = #{revokeReason}, update_time = now()
where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0
update basket_captain_qualification set is_current = 0, update_time = now() where member_id = #{memberId} and is_current = 1 and is_delete = 0
mapper.select: select from basket_captain_qualification where player_id = #{playerId} and is_current = 1 and is_delete = 0 order by granted_time desc limit 1

select count(1) from basket_captain_qualification cq inner join basket_player_profile pp on pp.id = cq.player_id and pp.is_delete = 0 where cq.player_id = #{playerId} and cq.is_current = 1 and cq.qualification_status = 1 and cq.payment_confirmed = 1 and cq.is_delete = 0 and pp.certification_status = 3 and (cq.valid_from is null or cq.valid_from <= now()) and (cq.valid_to is null or cq.valid_to >= now())

select cq.id as qualificationId, cq.qualification_no as qualificationNo, cq.qualification_status as qualificationStatus, cq.payment_confirmed as paymentConfirmed, cq.payment_reference as paymentReference, cq.granted_time as grantedTime, cq.valid_to as validTo, cq.revoked_time as revokedTime, cq.revoke_reason as revokeReason, cq.granted_by as grantedBy, s.season_name as seasonName, tm.tournament_name as tournamentName, coalesce(nullif(trim(s.season_name), ''), tm.tournament_name) as eventName, t.team_name as teamName, t.id as teamId, su.nick_name as grantedByName from basket_captain_qualification cq left join basket_tournament_season s on s.id = cq.season_id and s.is_delete = 0 left join basket_tournament tm on tm.id = s.tournament_id and tm.is_delete = 0 left join basket_team t on t.id = cq.team_id and t.is_delete = 0 left join sys_user su on su.user_id = cq.granted_by where cq.member_id = #{memberId} and cq.is_delete = 0 order by cq.granted_time desc, cq.id desc

select from basket_captain_qualification where member_id = #{memberId} and season_id = #{seasonId} and qualification_status = 1 and is_delete = 0 and (team_id is null or team_id = #{teamId}) order by granted_time desc, id desc limit 1
